subject.title: [Bug]: Code Mode hides policy-required direct message delivery

question: Should the protected `maintainer` issue be assigned to the Code Mode/provider-routing owner for immediate validation and repair?
rationale: The report alleges message-delivery loss across shared agent and provider paths, but the available environment prevented the source and history inspection needed to route or close it safely.

options.title: Validate and repair on current main
options.body: Run the supplied focused regressions against the Code Mode catalog and both provider payload shapes, then land a narrow shared-path fix if they fail.

options.title: Request a narrowed ownership boundary
options.body: Ask the reporter or area owner to identify the exact catalog and provider adapter files if the current reproduction cannot be located quickly.

recommendation.title: Validate and repair on current main
recommendation.body: Run the supplied focused regressions against the Code Mode catalog and both provider payload shapes, then land a narrow shared-path fix if they fail.
